Package org.apache.poi.util

Class LittleEndianInputStream

java.lang.Object
java.io.InputStream
java.io.FilterInputStream
org.apache.poi.util.LittleEndianInputStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, LittleEndianInput
Direct Known Subclasses:
ChunkedCipherInputStream
public class LittleEndianInputStream extends FilterInputStream implements LittleEndianInput
Wraps an InputStream providing LittleEndianInput

This class does not buffer any input, so the stream read position maintained by this class is consistent with that of the inner stream.

    • skipFully

      public void skipFully(long len) throws IOException
      Skips exactly len bytes.

      The bytes are read rather than skipped with skip(long), as some streams don't report the end of the stream when skipping (see IO-203).

      Parameters:
      len - the number of bytes to skip
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if len is negative
      IllegalStateException - if the end of the stream is reached first
      IOException - if the stream can't be read
